name: order-aggregator

description.en: Orders from a marketplace (Wolt-type) should arrive by the partner's signed webhook and be fetched, accepted and marked ready through its Order API. Today staff type them in from the platform's tablet; the hand-entry half is probed on qa-durres, the partner half needs a partner account.
description.uk: Замовлення з маркетплейсу (типу Wolt) мали б приходити підписаним вебхуком партнера; сьогодні персонал вводить їх вручну, і лише цю половину можна перевірити на qa-durres.

producer.what: POST /api/staff/orders/aggregator (hand entry; the partner webhook does not exist yet)

consumer.what: order id <channel>-<external id>, idempotent, price_trusted false, born CONFIRMED

external.api_version: Order API v1 paths + GET /v2/orders/{id} (OrderV2); base https://pos-integration-service.wolt.com, test https://pos-integration-service.development.dev.woltapi.com; fetched from developer.wolt.com/docs/webhook and /docs/api/order on 2026-10-03
external.auth: Authorization: Bearer <JWT from the OAuth 2.0 flow>; webhook header WOLT-SIGNATURE = HEX HMAC-SHA256(body, client secret); 3 retries at 5 s; ack with 200
external.glovo: Glovo partner API not fetched: UNVERIFIED

auth.where: MISSING: operator needs a Wolt partner (POS integration) account

response_schema.$comment: our hand-entry route's answer: the order as stored and whether it already was

schema_status: partner side from the vendor doc; hand-entry side draft
probe: Hand-entry half on qa-durres: enter wolt-LIVE<run> twice -> the first order both times; a different basket -> 409; end the order. Partner half NEEDS-KEY.
